capabilities: Create trip folders with a name and currency code
Record daily expenses with amount, place, and category
Show trip statistics as share charts and totals by category, date, and place
Edit or delete recorded expenses from dashboard or day views
Rename, hide, or show shared expense categories and set the ledger folder
extras: Interface defaults to Korean with an English option; stores expenses in day-file frontmatter and preserves note bodies; makes no network requests or analytics; one fixed currency per trip with no conversion.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log trip expenses by date and review spending totals per trip.
summary: Trip expense tracker that records daily spending per trip in dated Markdown files and shows totals by category, date, and place.
